Cowl Pinwheels and Ribbons is a simple piece that allows you to knit one pinwheel and one ribbon at a time; you knit straight pins, and then knit pins back to get ribs. To create a tight, tight tubular shape of the bowl without a connecting seam, you connect a pinwheel row to a ribbon row. It is all completely "natural" in every way, and a joy to knit. You can make three or four rows of ribbon for a small teepee, or a long, simpler "drape" (a pinwheel row makes the fabric wider, while a row of ribbon keeps it from folding in; that's why you want fewer rows of ribbon).
